The Unsplash API provides access to the world's largest open collection of high-quality, freely usable photos. Authentication uses Client-ID for public access or OAuth 2.0 Bearer tokens for user-authenticated operations. Rate limits: 50 req/hr (demo), 1000 req/hr (production).
